m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Well met, young Wizard. Fitzhume told me the Arcanum had a new Initiate. He said you were unworthy, but he can sometimes be... unfair.
Judging by your attire, I can tell you have good fashion sense, and I suspect you have great magical aptitude as well. We will see soon enough.
I am an Arcanum Sentinel, sworn to protect the Spiral, but I also serve as Arbiter Proctis, testing Initiates. Come in and I will test you.
I warn you now. I am here to test the very limits of your magical prowess. I will not pull any punches.
Bravo, Initiate. You have proven Fitzhume's assessment was completely wrong. I have no doubts as to your worth, and your courage.
I will inform the Scholars of your success. They will entrust you with greater responsibilities. Arrivederci. Until we meet again.
You look out and wonder... where are we? Where is the library? But your thinking is too traditional. As an Initiate, you must let that go.
Like the Arcanum itself, this chamber exists in a place of its own, between, beneath, behind, and beyond the rings of the Spiral.
Likewise, your success as an Initiate depends upon your ability to transcend your knowledge, your skills, and your philosophy.
Well done, Initiate. I understand that Cyrio was impressed with your proficiency elegance of form. He believes you'll fit in well here.
The knowledge now at your disposal is incomprehensibly vast. The Arcanum will expose a new layer of reality that lies behind all things.
This spell is but a small token compared to those I hope to share with you in the future. It's a sad spell, but mostly for your enemies.
You must visit often and keep me updated on your work, as I will keep you updated on mine. Together, we will advance the arts of Necromancy.
Welcome back to the Hall of Necromancy, Initiate. Like me, you clearly have a proclivity for the Dark Arts.
Some see us as agents of disease and corruption, but it's not so grotesque. Death is solely a function of time. We simply embrace that reality.
It's my personal mission to correct such misperceptions and along those lines, I'd like to share one of my more elegant spells with you.
Unfortunately, proper decorum demands you prove yourself first. The Arbiter Proctis, Cyrio Cassini, will administer the test.
It would be tragic were I not able to share this spell with you, but it depends on you. I suggest you see Cyrio at your earliest convenience.
